title: Relative affine space represents tuples of global functions
statement: Let $B$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $d\geq0$ an integer, and $f:Y\to B$ a scheme over $B$. For the relative affine space [def-sbc-affine-space], pullback of its coordinate functions gives a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_B(Y,\mathbf A^d_B)\cong\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)^d$. Its inverse sends a tuple $(v_1,\ldots,v_d)$ to the coordinate morphism with those pulled-back coordinates. This bijection is natural in the $B$-scheme $Y$.
